result.summary: This PR adds a functional test to feature_cltv.py exercising OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY with unix-timestamp locktimes through full block validation, checking that a CLTV-locked output is only accepted once BIP113 median-time-past satisfies the locktime. It also adds a test to feature_csv_activation.py showing that median-time-past can never exceed UINT32_MAX, so an output with nLockTime == UINT32_MAX can never be confirmed. The PR went through several rounds of review discussion clarifying test overlap with existing unit tests before being reorganized across the two files.
result.problem: Existing coverage of BIP65 unix-timestamp locktimes (transaction_tests.cpp) calls VerifyScript() directly and never exercises MTP or block connection, and existing MTP-vs-locktime tests (miner_tests.cpp, feature_csv_activation.py) don't exercise OP_CLTV specifically. This leaves a documented gap in coverage for how CLTV, BIP113, and block validation interact, including an edge case at the UINT32_MAX boundary.
